SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.base_score + IFNULL(agg.delta, 0) DESC, s.student_no ASC ) AS `rank`, s.id AS studentId, s.student_no AS studentNo, s.name AS `name`, s.class_id AS classId, c.name AS className, g.grade_name AS gradeName, IFNULL(agg.add_score, 0) AS addScore, -IFNULL(agg.deduct_score, 0) AS deductScore, s.base_score AS baseScore, s.base_score + IFNULL(agg.delta, 0) AS totalScore FROM `student` s JOIN `sys_class` c ON c.id = s.class_id LEFT JOIN `sys_grade` g ON g.id = c.grade_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT i.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN i.category = 2 THEN -i.points ELSE i.points END) AS delta, SUM(CASE WHEN i.category = 1 THEN i.points END) AS add_score, SUM(CASE WHEN i.category = 2 THEN i.points END) AS deduct_score FROM `score_item` i WHERE i.term = #{term} AND i.status = 2 AND i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.student_id ) agg ON agg.student_id = s.id
) t ORDER BY t.`rank` LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `student` s JOIN `sys_class` c ON c.id = s.class_id

SELECT s.id AS studentId, s.student_no AS studentNo, s.name AS `name`, s.class_id AS classId, c.name AS className, g.grade_name AS gradeName, IFNULL(agg.add_score, 0) AS addScore, -IFNULL(agg.deduct_score, 0) AS deductScore, s.base_score AS baseScore, s.base_score + IFNULL(agg.delta, 0) AS totalScore FROM `student` s JOIN `sys_class` c ON c.id = s.class_id LEFT JOIN `sys_grade` g ON g.id = c.grade_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT i.student_id, SUM(CASE WHEN i.category = 2 THEN -i.points ELSE i.points END) AS delta, SUM(CASE WHEN i.category = 1 THEN i.points END) AS add_score, SUM(CASE WHEN i.category = 2 THEN i.points END) AS deduct_score FROM `score_item` i WHERE i.term = #{term} AND i.status = 2 AND i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.student_id ) agg ON agg.student_id = s.id WHERE s.id = #{studentId}

SELECT i.*, st.student_no AS studentNo, st.name AS studentName, c.name AS className, d.dept_name AS deptName, u.real_name AS submitterName FROM `score_item` i JOIN `student` st ON st.id = i.student_id JOIN `sys_class` c ON c.id = i.class_id LEFT JOIN `sys_dept` d ON d.id = i.dept_id LEFT JOIN `sys_user` u ON u.id = i.submitted_by
ORDER BY i.submitted_at DESC, i.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT i.*, st.student_no AS studentNo, st.name AS studentName, c.name AS className FROM `score_item` i JOIN `student` st ON st.id = i.student_id JOIN `sys_class` c ON c.id = i.class_id
ORDER BY i.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT i.*, st.student_no AS studentNo, st.name AS studentName, c.name AS className, d.dept_name AS deptName, u.real_name AS submitterName, r.real_name AS reviewerName, o.occurred_on AS originOccurredOn, o.points AS originPoints, o.reason AS originReason FROM `score_item` i JOIN `student` st ON st.id = i.student_id JOIN `sys_class` c ON c.id = i.class_id LEFT JOIN `sys_dept` d ON d.id = i.dept_id LEFT JOIN `sys_user` u ON u.id = i.submitted_by LEFT JOIN `sys_user` r ON r.id = i.reviewed_by LEFT JOIN `score_item` o ON o.id = i.origin_id WHERE i.id = #{id} AND i.deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `score_item` WHERE id = #{id} AND created_by = #{userId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT i.*, st.student_no AS studentNo, st.name AS studentName, c.name AS className, d.dept_name AS deptName, u.real_name AS submitterName, r.real_name AS reviewerName FROM `score_item` i JOIN `student` st ON st.id = i.student_id JOIN `sys_class` c ON c.id = i.class_id LEFT JOIN `sys_dept` d ON d.id = i.dept_id LEFT JOIN `sys_user` u ON u.id = i.submitted_by LEFT JOIN `sys_user` r ON r.id = i.reviewed_by
ORDER BY i.occurred_on DESC, i.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN i.category = 1 THEN i.points ELSE 0 END), 0) AS addPoints, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN i.category = 2 THEN i.points ELSE 0 END), 0) AS deductPoints FROM `score_item` i

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.student_no) AS `rank`, s.id AS studentId, s.student_no AS studentNo, s.name AS `name`, s.class_id AS classId, c.name AS className, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN i.category = 1 THEN i.points END), 0) AS addScore, -IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN i.category = 2 THEN i.points END), 0) AS deductScore, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN i.dimension = 1 THEN (CASE WHEN i.category = 2 THEN -i.points ELSE i.points END) END), 0) AS deScore, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN i.dimension = 2 THEN (CASE WHEN i.category = 2 THEN -i.points ELSE i.points END) END), 0) AS zhiScore, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN i.dimension = 3 THEN (CASE WHEN i.category = 2 THEN -i.points ELSE i.points END) END), 0) AS tiScore, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN i.dimension = 4 THEN (CASE WHEN i.category = 2 THEN -i.points ELSE i.points END) END), 0) AS meiScore, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN i.dimension = 5 THEN (CASE WHEN i.category = 2 THEN -i.points ELSE i.points END) END), 0) AS laoScore, s.base_score AS baseScore, s.base_score + IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN i.category = 2 THEN -i.points ELSE i.points END), 0) AS totalScore,
IFNULL(GROUP_CONCAT( CASE WHEN i.category = 1 THEN CONCAT( i.seq, '.', i.reason, '(+', TRIM(TRAILING '.' FROM TRIM(TRAILING '0' FROM CAST(i.points AS CHAR))), ')', IF(i.occurred_on IS NULL, '', CONCAT('(', DATE_FORMAT(i.occurred_on, '%m.%d'), ')')) ) END ORDER BY i.seq SEPARATOR ''), '') AS addRemark,
IFNULL(GROUP_CONCAT( CASE WHEN i.category = 2 THEN CONCAT( i.seq, '.', i.reason, '(-', TRIM(TRAILING '.' FROM TRIM(TRAILING '0' FROM CAST(i.points AS CHAR))), ')', IF(i.occurred_on IS NULL, '', CONCAT('(', DATE_FORMAT(i.occurred_on, '%m.%d'), ')')) ) END ORDER BY i.seq SEPARATOR ''), '') AS deductRemark FROM `student` s JOIN `sys_class` c ON c.id = s.class_id LEFT JOIN (
SELECT id, student_id, category, dimension, points, reason, occurred_on, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY student_id, category ORDER BY occurred_on, id) AS seq FROM `score_item` WHERE term = #{term} AND status = 2 AND deleted = 0 ) i ON i.student_id = s.id WHERE s.class_id = #{classId} AND s.status = 1 GROUP BY s.id, s.student_no, s.name, s.class_id, c.name, s.base_score ORDER BY s.student_no
